AD, Asthma, EoE, CRSwNP, PN, COPD, CSU

BENCHMARK. Treatment policy estimand counts exacerbations regardless of background therapy changes — pragmatic design that proves efficacy in real-world heterogeneous populations. Q2W SC. TMDD limits half-life. ~14.2B 2024 revenue. Conjunctivitis 10–20% in AD. Patent expiry 2031–2033.

NAVIGATOR trial (NEJM 2021): treatment policy estimand — exacerbations counted even when patients changed ICS doses mid-trial. This pragmatic design is why it demonstrated efficacy across all endotypes (low-eos, non-eosinophilic asthma). SUNRISE COPD positive 2024. Validates TSLP target at scale.

Anti-IL-13 mAb. Approved AD EU/US. Efficacy comparable to dupilumab with potentially fewer injection site reactions. Less conjunctivitis. Q4W maintenance dosing advantage. Validates anti-cytokine approach post-dupilumab; sets bar for bispecifics to show incremental benefit beyond pure cytokine blockade.

Anti-IL-13 mAb. Approved AD. Q2W → Q4W maintenance. Growing evidence that pure anti-IL-13 is active in a subset that does not respond fully to dupilumab's broader IL-4Rα blockade. Validates the IL-13 component; bispecifics combining IL-4Rα (broader) + TSLP (upstream) offer a different angle.
